title: CIA-UAP-015, Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14 (Analysis of Reports of Unidentified Aerial Objects)
doc_notes: This document is the USAF Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, which provides a statistical analysis of UAP reports from 1947 through 1952, including a CIA cover sheet. / This document is the USAF Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, which provides a statistical analysis of UAP sightings from 1947 to 1952, including various charts, histograms, and Chi Square tests comparing known and unknown object reports. / This document is the USAF Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, which provides a statistical analysis of UAP reports and includes a detailed examination of 12 'good' unknown sightings. / This document is the USAF Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, containing statistical tables of UAP reports categorized by various factors, with a CIA cover sheet. / This document is a statistical analysis report from USAF Project Blue Book (Special Report No. 14) containing numerous tables categorizing UAP reports by evaluation, certainty, and various conditions, with a CIA 'Official Record Copy' cover sheet. / This document is the statistical appendix of USAF Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, containing extensive tables categorizing UAP reports by year, evaluation, and various witness/object characteristics. / This document is the USAF Project Blue Book Special Report No. 14, which provides a statistical analysis of UAP reports, including various data tables and coding forms for data processing.

incidents.summary: Kenneth Arnold sighting of a chainlike formation of disc-shaped objects near Mount Rainier, Washington.
Two men in a rug-cleaning firm saw a shiny, metallic object glide across a road at low altitude.
incidents.quote: It was shiny and metallic in construction, about 6 to 8 feet long and 2 feet wide.

incidents.summary: Naval aviation student and others at a drive-in movie observed multiple groups of objects flying over.
incidents.quote: The unaccountable feature of the objects was that each had a red glow surrounding it and was glowing itself

incidents.summary: Tower operators and commercial pilots observed a light that performed maneuvers near their aircraft.
incidents.quote: In appearance, it was like an airplane with a cigar-shaped body and straight wings, somewhat larger than a B-29.

incidents.summary: Farmer and hired hand observed two cigar-shaped objects hovering and moving.
incidents.quote: It was stated that they appeared to be transparent and illuminated from the inside.

incidents.summary: Pilot and copilot of a DC-3 observed an object with lighted windows passing them.
incidents.quote: The object seemed powered by rocket or jet motors shooting a trail of fire some 50 feet to the rear

incidents.summary: Instrument technician observed an object moving in spurts and rolling.
incidents.quote: It suddenly moved up toward the zenith in spurts from right to left at an angle of about 45°.

incidents.summary: Flight Sergeant observed an object performing spinning and tumbling actions.
incidents.quote: The object flew in a series of spinning and tumbling actions.

incidents.summary: Electrician observed an object flying straight and level.
incidents.quote: Total time in sight was approximately 10 seconds, during which the object flew on a straight and level course

incidents.summary: Farmer and sons observed a sky blue object hedge hopping.
incidents.quote: It was hedge hopping, following the contour of the ground, was sky blue, about 20 feet in diameter

incidents.summary: Laboratory employees observed a metallic object with a dirty skin.
incidents.quote: It was of metallic construction and was seen with good enough resolution to show that the skin was dirty.

incidents.summary: Airliner crew observed a disc-shaped object with portholes and purple light.
incidents.quote: The object appeared to be circular, with a diameter of approximately 100 feet

incidents.summary: Musician observed a hovering object with propellers and windows.
incidents.quote: It was about 75 feet long, 45 feet wide, and 15 feet thick, shaped like two oval meat platters placed together.
incidents.size: 75 feet long, 45 feet wide, 15 feet thick

Statistical analysis of UAP reports from 1947-1952, categorized by evaluation type (Balloon, Astronomical, Aircraft, etc.) and confidence levels.
